rationale: The agent verified the user correctly using full name and prior zip code. It did not reveal or alter any account data without proper authentication and explicit details. For the address update, the agent appropriately requested the full new address and did not proceed without it, aligning with policy. For the t-shirt request, the agent used tools to retrieve the product variants, accurately identified the cheapest option, and correctly stated that an order would require a shipping address and payment method. The agent did not perform any write actions without confirmation, did not fabricate details, and provided accurate pricing and availability for other items. Although the user’s address wasn’t updated and no order was placed due to the user withholding the address, the agent handled all requests in line with policy and provided correct information throughout.
